name: closeyourit-angular-21-proof
//: @modelcontextprotocol/sdk 1.30.0 has a known flaw, fixed from 1.31.0. It comes from @angular/cli
21.2.25, which requires it exactly for its MCP server: development tool only, it does not end up in
the example's build nor in the published package. 1.31.0 only changes the minor number and declares
the same dependencies, so it is forced with an override. @angular/cli 21.2.26 already requires 1.31.0:
when the example moves to Angular 21.2.26 or later the override must be removed. See CYJS-62.
